comment: A6 end-to-end orientation fixtures (B1, 2026-06-13). Near-final turn-start states from two decided elite human games (provenance: human_elite_2000_45s_v2), covering winner-to-move and loser-to-move from BOTH seats. expected='high' means the MOVER is the eventual winner (engine airootwinrate should read decisively > threshold); 'low' means the mover lost. A maxPlayer sign flip at the NeuralNet.cpp evaluateValue seam inverts all four.
